description: Pauses playbook execution for a set amount of time, or until a prompt is acknowledged. All parameters are optional. The default behavior is to pause with a prompt.

parameters.name: echo
parameters.description: Controls whether or not keyboard input is shown when typing. Only has effect if neither seconds nor minutes are set. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: minutes
parameters.description: A positive number of minutes to pause for.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Optional text to use for the prompt message. User input is only returned if seconds and minutes are both not specified, otherwise this is just a custom message before playbook execution is paused.

parameters.name: seconds
parameters.description: A positive number of seconds to pause for.

examples:
- name: Pause for 5 minutes to build app cache
  ansible.builtin.pause:
    minutes: 5

- name: Pause until you can verify updates to an application were successful
  ansible.builtin.pause:

- name: A helpful reminder of what to look out for post-update
  ansible.builtin.pause:
    prompt: "Make sure org.foo.FooOverload exception is not present"

- name: Pause to get some sensitive input
  ansible.builtin.pause:
    prompt: "Enter a secret"
    echo: no

return_values.name: delta
return_values.description: Time paused in seconds Returned: always Sample: "2"

return_values.name: echo
return_values.description: Value of echo setting Returned: always Sample: true

return_values.name: start
return_values.description: Time when started pausing Returned: always Sample: "2017-02-23 14:35:07.298862"

return_values.name: stdout
return_values.description: Output of pause module Returned: always Sample: "Paused for 0.04 minutes"

return_values.name: stop
return_values.description: Time when ended pausing Returned: always Sample: "2017-02-23 14:35:09.552594"

return_values.name: user_input
return_values.description: User input from interactive console Returned: if no waiting time set Sample: "Example user input"
